name: Muurschildering van Keith Haring
description: Keith Haring painted this 15-by-12-metre fantasy animal and its rider on the west wall of the Koelhuis in 1986, during his Stedelijk Museum exhibition. The rider carries an Amsterdam St Andrew’s cross. This mostly windowless 1935 cold-storage building later held museum collections. Metal cladding hid the work until 2018; restoration followed in 2020. It is on the former museum depot, north of the Centrale Markthal, and can be viewed across the water from Willem de Zwijgerlaan.
